label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~85), mostly when choosing a1
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass); it never fires at D2 and only trivially at D1. It is an episode-clock feature: it is silent before trial ~65, rare at 70-79, and rises sharply at 80-89 and 90-99 (85% of mass is in trials 90-99). It coincides with low value-head output, which also falls late in the episode. Within late GO steps it prefers a1 choices: model_act==1 holds 87% of mass (a1 GO rate 11% vs a2 1.8%). Choosing a2 activates it only weakly, except at the very end of the episode, where a2 GO steps also fire strongly. It is somewhat stronger after an unrewarded previous trial. It does not depend on transition type or reward pattern. ep_trial >= 85 alone at GO gives recall 0.91 and mass recall 0.96 but precision 0.38. Adding model_act==1 (the agent's own policy at that step, observable) gives dev F1 0.74 and mass recall 0.84. Magnitude grows with lateness in the episode.
